name: inkypos
description: InkyPOS 2.0 monorepo: Expo POS client, shared TypeScript core, Laravel API

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix packages/core && npm install --prefix apps/pos
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:pos && npm run test:api
scripts.test:api: cd apps/api && php -d extension=sodium -d extension=pdo_sqlite -d extension=sqlite3 vendor/bin/phpunit
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix packages/core && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/pos
